result:
I changed only `static/style.css`, with no JavaScript and no template changes. Clicking around should now cross-fade between pages instead of blinking. I haven't seen it in a browser, so I can't confirm the effect visually; my automated check only showed the app still works.

**What I added:**
- **`@view-transition { navigation: auto; }`**: tells the browser to fade from one page to the next.
- **The top bar has its own transition name**, so it stays still while the page content fades underneath it.
- **The fade lasts 150ms**, short enough that clicks still feel instant.
- **`html { background: #f8f9fa; }`**: removes the brief white flash before each page draws.
- **Turned off for anyone whose system is set to reduce motion.**

**Browser support:** this works in Chrome, Edge and Safari 18.2+. Other browsers ignore the rule and load pages exactly as before, though the white-flash fix applies everywhere.

To see it, restart `python app.py` and do a hard refresh (Cmd+Shift+R) so the browser picks up the new CSS. Then click between the week view, a run, and previous/next week.
